intro: The Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) delivers a perfectly balanced meal with tender grilled chicken, roasted vegetables, and creamy hummus wrapped in warm pita bread. At 680 calories with 42g of protein, this Mediterranean-inspired pita offers satisfying flavor without the guilt. Priced between $12.95 and $13.95, it is a popular choice for those seeking a nutritious, flavorful meal that is ready in minutes.
priceCalories: The Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita costs $12.95 to $13.95 depending on location, making it a mid-range option on the [full CAVA menu](/). With 680 calories, 42g of protein, 62g of carbs, and 28g of fat, it provides balanced nutrition for lunch or dinner. This pita offers excellent value compared to similar items, delivering quality ingredients and substantial portion sizes that keep you satisfied throughout the day.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this pita apart is the aromatic garlic dressing that ties all ingredients together with bold Mediterranean flavor. The combination of grilled chicken with roasted vegetables creates a satisfying texture contrast, while creamy hummus adds richness. Unlike heavier fast-casual options, this pita balances indulgence with nutrition. The careful selection of fresh ingredients and the signature garlic dressing make it a standout choice on the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas).
nutritionFacts: Each Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita contains 680 calories with a macro breakdown of 42g protein, 62g carbohydrates, and 28g fat. The high protein content supports muscle maintenance and satiety, while the moderate calorie count fits most dietary plans. The roasted vegetables add fiber and micronutrients, and the hummus provides healthy fats. For detailed nutritional information across all items, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan your perfect meal.
whatsInside: This pita features warm pita bread filled with seasoned grilled chicken, colorful roasted vegetables, and creamy hummus from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/dips-spreads). Fresh shredded romaine adds crunch, while the signature garlic dressing brings everything together with robust flavor. Each ingredient is carefully portioned to create the perfect bite. The roasted vegetables typically include seasonal options like peppers, onions, and zucchini, adding both nutrition and Mediterranean authenticity to every serving.
tasteLike: The Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita offers a bold, savory flavor profile dominated by aromatic garlic notes. The grilled chicken provides a mild, slightly smoky base, while roasted vegetables add natural sweetness and char. Creamy hummus brings nutty richness, and the garlic dressing delivers pungent, herbaceous notes that permeate each bite. The crisp romaine adds refreshing texture contrast. The warm pita bread ties everything together, creating a cohesive Mediterranean experience that is both comforting and exciting.
customize: Personalize your Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita by adding extra toppings from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/toppings) like feta cheese, pickled onions, or cucumbers. Swap the garlic dressing for options from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/dressings) such as lemon herb tahini or harissa vinaigrette. Request extra hummus or add spicy feta spread for more flavor. You can also increase the protein portion or add avocado for healthy fats. Customization is easy and allows you to create your ideal pita combination.
pairsWell: Complete your meal by pairing the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita with options from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) like crispy pita chips or roasted vegetables. The Greek Salad side complements the Mediterranean flavors perfectly. For beverages, try a refreshing lemonade or sparkling water from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). If you are still hungry, the pita pairs well with hummus as an appetizer, creating a satisfying, well-rounded meal experience.
healthyChoice: With 42g of protein and only 680 calories, the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita is an excellent choice for health-conscious diners. The grilled chicken provides lean protein without excess fat, while roasted vegetables deliver essential vitamins and fiber. Hummus offers plant-based protein and healthy fats. The balanced macros support weight management and sustained energy. Compared to typical fast-food options, this pita delivers superior nutrition without sacrificing flavor, making it ideal for active lifestyles and balanced eating plans.
howToOrder: Order the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita in-store by selecting it from the curated pitas section, or find it easily on the CAVA app or website. It comes pre-configured with all signature ingredients, but you can request modifications at no extra charge for most toppings. For a complete Mediterranean experience, explore the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) for similar flavor combinations. The pita is prepared fresh to order, typically ready within five minutes.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greek Chicken Pita at 720 calories, the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita offers slightly fewer calories while maintaining robust flavor. The Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita delivers 930 calories with more heat and richness. The Crispy Falafel Pita provides a vegetarian option at 750 calories. For red meat lovers, the Steak + Feta Pita at 820 calories offers a heartier alternative. The Garlic Chicken + Veggie strikes the best balance between nutrition, flavor, and value.
whoShouldTry: This pita is perfect for garlic lovers who appreciate bold Mediterranean flavors without excessive calories. Fitness enthusiasts will appreciate the 42g protein content for muscle recovery and satiety. Busy professionals seeking a quick, nutritious lunch will find it ideal. Those exploring the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) should note it contains gluten and sesame. Anyone wanting a balanced meal that does not compromise on taste should try this popular curated option.
worthTrying: The Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita is absolutely worth trying for its perfect balance of nutrition, flavor, and value. The signature garlic dressing and quality ingredients justify the $12.95-$13.95 price point. With 680 well-balanced calories and impressive protein content, it satisfies both your taste buds and nutritional needs. Whether you are a CAVA regular or first-time visitor, this pita showcases what makes Mediterranean fast-casual dining so appealing and consistently delicious.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita?
faqs.a: The Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita contains 680 calories with 42g protein, 62g carbs, and 28g fat. This balanced macro profile makes it suitable for most dietary plans while providing satisfying nutrition and energy.

faqs.q: What is the price of the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita?
faqs.a: The Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita is priced between $12.95 and $13.95 depending on your location. This competitive price point reflects the quality ingredients and generous portion size included in every order.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita?
faqs.a: Yes, you can fully customize your pita by adding or removing ingredients, changing dressings, or adding extra toppings. Most modifications are available at no additional charge, allowing you to create your perfect Mediterranean wrap.

faqs.q: Is the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, the pita contains gluten from the pita bread. However, you can order the same ingredients as a bowl or salad for a gluten-free alternative. Check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) for more options.

faqs.q: What makes the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita healthy?
faqs.a: This pita features lean grilled chicken, nutrient-rich roasted vegetables, and protein-packed hummus for just 680 calories. The balanced macros, high protein content, and whole food ingredients make it a nutritious choice for any meal.
